job.title: Python Software Engineer
job.description: We are looking for a Python backend engineer with strong foundation in buildingREST APIs, Pandas, FastAPI framework. big adbamtages if you have experience with AWS and Google Cloud. Remote work is possible for the right candidate.

ai_analysis.summary: Good technical match for a junior Python/backend profile: Python, backend work, REST APIs, and FastAPI are directly relevant, and remote work is possible. The main downside is that the role is listed as onsite in Madrid, which is less aligned with the candidate’s remote preference, and the listing suggests a stronger backend profile than a true junior role. Still, it is worth applying because the core stack match is strong.
strengths: Strong overlap with Python, FastAPI, backend, and REST API experience
Remote work may be possible despite onsite listing
SQL and Docker are relevant supporting skills
Role aligns with candidate's junior backend direction
gaps: Onsite in Madrid, while candidate prefers remote/europe/usa/canada
No explicit mention of junior level or internship
Pandas, AWS, and Google Cloud are mentioned as bonuses but are not in the candidate profile
Could be more competitive than an entry-level role
ai_analysis.role_description: Python backend engineer focused on building REST APIs, using FastAPI and Pandas, with AWS and Google Cloud as advantages. Remote work may be possible.
ai_analysis.application_advice: Apply if the candidate is open to onsite or partial flexibility in Madrid. Tailor the resume toward FastAPI, REST APIs, backend work, and any API integration projects. Mention willingness to learn cloud tools and emphasize practical Python projects. If the candidate is strictly remote-only, this becomes a weaker option.
